bonds with Joey over being killed off a soap
the coffeehouse's enforcer — 'the Gunther card' wins the couch back

resents Ross ('What does Rachel see in this guy?', 'like you don't already have everything')
knows Rachel's wardrobe ('Rachel has those in burgundy')

Rachel quits on him, which pushes her toward the fashion job

former smoker: 'Oh dark mother, once again I suckle at your smoky tit'
is the one who tells Rachel about Ross and the girl from the Xerox place — 'Was I not supposed to?'

keeps courting her with small gestures ('Rachel, I made you a cocoa')
